postcondition.error_message: Bootstrapped runtime service account must exist and be enabled.
Bootstrapped runtime custom role is missing, deleted or differs from infrastructure/iam/runtime_roles.json.
Provisioner custom role is missing, deleted or differs from infrastructure/iam/provisioner.role.json.

postcondition.condition: ${anytrue([for b in try(jsondecode(self.policy_data).bindings, []) : b.role == format("projects/%s/roles/%s", var.project_id, data.google_project_iam_custom_role.runtime["jobs"].role_id) && contains(try(b.members, []), "serviceAccount:${data.google_service_account.runner.email}") && try(b.condition, null) == null])}
postcondition.error_message: Bootstrap must grant the runner the jobs custom role at project scope, unconditionally.
Runner holds an unexpected project-level role; only the jobs custom role is permitted.

postcondition.condition: ${alltrue([for b in try(jsondecode(self.policy_data).bindings, []) : b.role == format("projects/%s/roles/%s", var.project_id, data.google_project_iam_custom_role.provision.role_id) || !contains(try(b.members, []), var.provisioner_member)])}
postcondition.error_message: Provisioner holds a project role other than its bootstrapped provision role (possible administrative escalation).

postcondition.condition: ${alltrue([for b in try(jsondecode(self.policy_data).bindings, []) : b.role != format("projects/%s/roles/%s", var.project_id, data.google_project_iam_custom_role.provision.role_id) || try(b.condition.expression, "") != ""])}
postcondition.error_message: Provisioner project binding must carry an expiring IAM condition.

runtime_roles.description: Expected bootstrapped runtime role definitions; verified, never created here.

provisioner_permissions.description: Expected provisioner custom-role permissions; verified, never created here.

provisioner_member.description: serviceAccount: member of the impersonated provisioner.
